content: The heartbeat version is NOT the stack package metadata — it is a hardcoded VERSION constant in a SEPARATE repo (~/sovereign-bridge/bridge.py). Stack metadata read 1.5.2 while the heartbeat still said 1.5.1 until I traced it; bump the bridge in lockstep or the canonical version display lies. Also: origin/main received a concurrent squash-merge (657f695) of the same Gemini work while I had merged it locally (--no-ff 5a0fede) — reconciled with merge -s ours after verifying origin was a strict content subset. And verify-the-load-bearing-claim paid off again: Gemini reported '~36 tools', I ran its proxy on HQ myself and it was the canonical 41.
